label: Causal station prefixes entail a locally feasible Reaper descent (inference)
rule: A finite-prefix witness covering n+1 supplies both actual PieceAt interfaces on the same schedule; project the station/causal requirements while retaining the anchored descent.
meaning: Selected finite-prefix compatibility of actually concrete, existing, temporally present and causally linked station bearers suffices for the previously registered selected-descent local Reaper premise. For each n, one prefix world witnesses two adjacent pieces. The witness, clock, schedule and station identities are held fixed in each application. This is a conditional strength order, not a source-warrant or metaphysical possibility result.
